about: Shared test vectors for the Study Desk's merge rules (src/lib/desk-merge.mjs; STUDY-DESK.md, 'When notes collide: rules a to e'). For each case, merging `incoming` into `local` as of `now` must give exactly `expect`, the whole notebook sorted by id, compared as JSON (key order does not matter). `local` is the side that is never clamped; `incoming` is the arriving side, which is clamped to `now` and checked. Exact ties go to the local copy (no tiebreak is given). A case with `skipped` also says how many incoming records must be reported and not written. `rule` names the rule the case is about: a (newer writing wins), b (deleted on one side, edited on the other), c (30-day trash, then a tombstone), collapse (two trash records for one deletion; the website's proposal of 2026-10-12, not yet confirmed by the apps), keep (principle 6), clamp, skip.
